Boston · Sat Nov 28 – Sun Nov 29, 2026 · sunny, high 52, west wind

Warm Boston Weekend

Two days, all indoors, never more than five minutes between a door and the next one. The cameras come out inside.

Saturday

Library, tea, golf, a jail cell, a fireplace

Everything is in Beacon Hill, Back Bay or downtown. Two cabs total. Book the Athenaeum tour, the tea, and a Five Iron bay in advance; the rest is walk-in.

10:30

Breakfast at Tatte

Charles St, Beacon Hill · 5 min walk to the Athenaeum

Shakshuka, pastries, a proper coffee, in the Beacon Hill one with the big windows. Get there before 11 or you'll queue.

Map ↗
11:30

Boston Athenaeum tour

10½ Beacon St · one of the oldest private libraries in America

Five floors of reading rooms, a fifth-floor terrace view over the Granary Burying Ground, and a book bound in human skin. Public tours run on set days; book the Saturday slot online.

Tours & tickets ↗
13:00

Afternoon tea at the Boston Public Library

Courtyard Tea Room, McKim building, Copley Sq · 15 min walk or a short cab

Three-tier tea with scones and sandwiches in a white room overlooking the library's Italian courtyard. Reservation needed on a holiday weekend; champagne optional.

Reserve ↗
14:45

Five Iron Golf

Downtown Boston · cab from Copley, 10 min

Indoor simulators with a bar. Book a bay for an hour, play Pebble Beach, order a drink. You can go easy on her. Or not.

Book a bay ↗
16:15

A drink in a jail cell at Alibi

The Liberty Hotel, 215 Charles St · the old Charles Street Jail

The bar is the former drunk tank: original brick, original cell bars, mug shots on the walls. One cocktail, then walk Charles Street under the holiday lights.

Map ↗
18:00

Dinner at the Oak Long Bar

Fairmont Copley Plaza, Back Bay · 10 min cab from the Liberty

Gilded ceilings, a long bar, a fireplace, and a kitchen that's better than a hotel's should be. The room is the point. Grill 23 across the street is the steakhouse alternative.

Map ↗

Weather note: Saturday's wind gusts to 26 mph, so the only outdoor stretch, Charles Street after Alibi, is the sheltered one. Everything else you're inside.

Sunday

Dim sum, wine, then the Bruins

Chinatown to the Garden is a ten-minute cab, and the last three stops share a building. Buy Bruins tickets now; Sunday against a West Coast team usually has seats.

12:00

Dim sum at Hei La Moon

88 Beach St, Chinatown · 10 min cab from Back Bay

Carts roll past, you point, they stamp your card. Shrimp dumplings, pork buns, turnip cake, egg tarts. Big round tables, loud, cheap, and a very Boston Sunday.

Map ↗
14:00

Wine flights at City Winery

80 Beverly St, Haymarket · 5 min walk to the Garden

They make the wine on site; the tasting bar does flights, no reservation. The alternative below is Roxy's A4cade if you'd rather play than sip.

Map ↗
15:45

Pregame at Hub Hall

Inside the Hub on Causeway, attached to TD Garden

A food hall with eighteen vendors and a bar, so you never go back outside. Grab a beer, watch warmups on the screens, walk straight into the arena.

Map ↗
17:00

Bruins vs. Canucks

TD Garden · puck drop 5:00pm

Beer, hot dogs, loud. Loge-level corners are the price-to-view sweet spot. The Garden is cold inside; bring a layer. Out by 7:45, cab home from Causeway Street.

Tickets ↗
Swap-ins

If one stop doesn't land

All indoors, all in the same neighborhoods. Trade any of these for a stop above.

Swap

Roxy's A4cade

Central Square, Cambridge

Barcade: pinball, Skee-Ball, 90s cabinets, Roxy's grilled cheese in the back. A warmer, sillier alternative to the winery on Sunday afternoon.

Map ↗
Swap

WNDR Museum

Downtown Crossing

Immersive rooms built for photographing each other: infinity mirrors, light floors, a Kusama. About an hour. Swap for Five Iron if golf isn't her thing.

Tickets ↗
Swap

Puttshack

Seaport

Tech mini-golf with a bar; scoring on screens, cocktails at every hole. Next to Snowport if you want five minutes of holiday market after.

Map ↗
Swap

Museum of Bad Art + a beer

Dorchester Brewing Co.

Sincerely terrible paintings with deadpan curator notes, inside a taproom. Thirty minutes of laughing, free, beer in hand.

Map ↗
Swap

Jazz brunch at the Beehive

South End · Sundays

Live band, velvet curtains, a brunch that takes two hours on purpose. Swap for dim sum if she'd rather sit than point at carts.
